svg.title: What one look at the phone costs the AI, in tokens
svg.desc: One real screen, a Xiaomi POCO X6 Pro home screen, counted with Claude Opus 5.5. Android's raw screen description: 11,565 tokens. A screenshot of the phone: 3,867 tokens. Agentroid: the full list: 1,241 tokens. Agentroid: the short answer: 229 tokens. Agentroid: 'what changed?': 35 tokens. Looks that fit in a 200,000-token context window: 17 raw screen description, 51 a screenshot, 161 Agentroid, full list, 873 Agentroid, short answer (the default).
